body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 6, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: On-call readiness for Route Experiments (beta expansion next week)

Team,

Ahead of expanding the Route Experiments beta enablement (next week per release train), SRE needs to sign off on on-call readiness. Can you confirm status / owners for the below by EOD?

1) Runbooks
- Assignment debugging runbook complete + reviewed (incl. known-bad patterns: missing sticky key, low-entropy default, cache skew, cross-region determinism drift)
- Propagation lag + config staleness runbook (what to do when results appear stale / configs not applying)
- Guardrail auto-stop behavior runbook (soft-stop vs hard-stop + kill switch)

2) Alerts (paging vs ticket)
- Config propagation lag
- Attribution drop rate
- Variant 0 traffic detection (variant receiving 0% for >N mins)
- Error rate + p99 latency regression guardrails (and how they interact w/ experiment state)

3) Escalation policy
- Which team is primary for: results API issues vs telemetry pipeline vs policy engine evaluator
- Slack channels + paging rotation mapping

If helpful, I can do a 30-min review today. I want to avoid beta expansion turning into a flood of noisy alerts with unclear ownership.

Thanks,
Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
SRE Lead
Redwood Inference



From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 6, 2025 at 10:01 AM PST
Subject: Re: On-call readiness for Route Experiments (beta expansion next week)

Sean,

+1 on the review. Quick status:

- Assignment debugging runbook: draft is in Confluence and pretty complete; we added sections for sticky-key precedence + the “missing sticky key => skew” failure mode. Needs final SRE pass.
- Propagation lag runbook: partial. We have the metrics + Grafana panels, but steps for “what to do” are still too hand-wavy.
- Guardrails: currently soft-stop (degraded banner + notification). Optional hard-stop exists behind a kill switch (feature flag) but we weren’t planning to enable for beta expansion.

Can we do 2:30pm PT? I’ll pull in Marissa + Logan.

Dylan

—
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Lead, Console & Tooling
Redwood Inference



From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 6, 2025 at 11:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: On-call readiness for Route Experiments (beta expansion next week)

Adding telemetry specifics for the alert discussion:

Attribution drop rate (definition): % of requests where router decision indicates experiment active but emitted spans/metrics are missing {experiment_id, variant_id}.

Known causes we’ve seen in staging:
- streaming retry path not carrying context (fixed in code, but want alert in case regression)
- async spans emitted before context is attached
- SDK callers not passing stickiness key -> doesn’t cause “drop” but causes noisy skew; we should not page on skew alone

Proposed thresholds (beta):
- Attribution drop > 1.0% for 15m => ticket (not page), includes link to dashboards + “check recent deploys”
- Attribution drop > 5.0% for 10m => page (we’re losing measurement + guardrails become meaningless)

For cardinality reasons we’re not alerting per {route, experiment_id} at first; only aggregate + top offenders in dashboard.

Logan



From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 6, 2025 at 12:07 PM PST
Subject: Re: On-call readiness for Route Experiments (beta expansion next week)

On the alerts: please ensure we don’t blow up metric costs by tagging alerts on high-cardinality dimensions.

SRE ask from last review still stands:
- Any page-triggering alert must be on low-cardinality signals (service-level propagation lag, overall attribution drop, etc.)
- Drill-down to {route, experiment_id, variant} should be dashboard-only.

If you need, I can join the 2:30 and sanity check the alert queries.

Priya



From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 6, 2025 at 2:06 PM PST
Subject: Re: On-call readiness for Route Experiments (beta expansion next week)

Confirming product expectations so we’re aligned for on-call:

- Beta expansion scope: we are NOT promising fully automated analysis/significance; Console shows deltas + guardrail status.
- Guardrails: default is soft-stop (mark degraded + notify). Hard-stop remains optional (and must have a kill switch), we should treat it as “break glass” until we’ve seen it behave safely.
- Support posture: if a customer reports “results not updating,” we want the runbook to first check propagation lag + aggregation freshness and provide an ETA or workaround.

If there’s a strong SRE preference to keep hard-stop disabled for beta expansion, I’m aligned.

Marissa



From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 6, 2025 at 3:22 PM PST
Subject: Re: On-call readiness for Route Experiments (beta expansion next week)

Looping in release context:

Beta expansion plan currently includes:
- enabling feature flag for 6 additional accounts (INT-1193-style requests)
- region-by-region rollout starting us-east, then eu-west

If SRE wants a “stop the world” lever:
- we can keep the feature flag allowlist in place (no broad enable) and require explicit approval to add accounts
- we can also coordinate a freeze window for the first 24h of expansion (no unrelated router changes)

Happy to update the checklist once we agree on the alerting + escalation policy.

Evelyn

—
Evelyn Hart
Engineering Leadership Ops
Redwood Inference



From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: On-call readiness for Route Experiments (beta expansion next week)

Works. Summary of what SRE needs before we expand:

A) Runbooks (must be explicit, copy/paste-able)
1) Propagation lag / stale results
- include: how to confirm lag (Grafana panel + metric name), expected bounds (beta), and immediate mitigation (rollback config version? invalidate cache? pause enablement?)
- include: customer-facing guidance for Support (what we say when results are delayed)

2) Assignment debugging
- include “explain assignment” steps + what data to capture for escalation (request_id, route, sticky key source, config version)

B) Alerts + routing
1) Paging
- Propagation lag: page when p99 staleness > 120s for 10m (service-level)
- Attribution drop: page when > 5% for 10m (service-level)

2) Ticket only
- Attribution drop > 1% for 15m
- Variant 0 traffic detection (unless it coincides with increased error rate / latency regression)

C) Escalation / ownership (write this down in the runbook)
- If propagation lag / config not applying: Platform oncall (router/policy engine) is primary, SRE secondary
- If attribution drop / missing tags: Telemetry oncall (Logan’s team) primary, SRE secondary
- If Console results view broken but underlying metrics OK: Console oncall primary

D) Operational policy for beta expansion
- Hard-stop remains disabled by default. If enabled for a specific account, must be acknowledged in the enablement ticket + include the kill switch location.
- I like Evelyn’s suggestion: keep allowlist + approve adds during first 24h.

Let’s use the 2:30 session to walk through dashboards and confirm the alert rules are in place with runbook links.

Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
SRE Lead
Redwood Inference
